bagPolicy.summary: Only small purses up to 13 × 4 × 9 inches are allowed and subject to search. Other bags and backpacks are prohibited, with no bag storage.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The operator offers advance passes for nearby paid parking; the parking structure beneath the Pabst is operated separately from the theater.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Pabst FAQ and parking page do not specify a designated rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The bar serves drinks from the posted door time through the performance. There is no food service; outside food, drinks and water are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible entry and seating are offered; contact the theater box office for a suitable location.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Pabst operator FAQ does not publish a general re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is at the box office with photo ID during normal hours or beginning two hours before showtime. The Pabst box office opens Tuesday–Friday noon–6 p.m., and two hours before weekend performances.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The event sets its own door time, which is when bar service begins. Bring only a small purse and allow time for its security search.
